xl:hidden" href="/blog/topic/product">product</a></div><h1 class="type-lg text-balance">Cursor is now available in JetBrains IDEs</h1><div class="mt-v5/12 type-base text-theme-text-mid"><span class="text-theme-text-mid">2 min read</span></div></header></div></div><div class="col-span-full grid grid-cols-subgrid xl:col-start-7 xl:col-end-19"><div class="col-span-full mx-auto w-full max-w-[48rem]"><div class="min-w-0"><nav id="contents" class="card card--text mb-v2 type-sm"><button class="flex w-full items-center justify-between text-left" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="toc-content"><h3 class="text-theme-text-sec">Table of Contents</h3><span class="text-theme-text-sec transition-transform duration-200"><span class="icon-glyph-11" Cursor in JetBrains IDEs</a></li><li><a href="#getting-started" class="py-v1/12 hover:text-theme-text-sec block ">Getting started</a></li><li><a href="#whats-next" class="py-v1/12 hover:text-theme-text-sec block ">What&#x27;s next</a></li></ul></div></nav><div class="prose prose--block prose--blog col-span-full!"><p>Cursor is now available in IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, and other JetBrains IDEs through the <a href="https://agentclientprotocol.com/" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Agent Client Protocol</a> (ACP).</p>
<p>Developers who rely on IntelliJ IDEA and other <a href="https://www.jetbrains.com/ides/" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">JetBrains IDEs</a> for strong Java and multilanguage support can now use any frontier model with Cursor for agent-driven development.</p>
<figure class="!my-1"><div style="aspect-ratio:1684 / 1080;overflow:hidden"><div class="media-border-container media-controller w-full " style="width:100%;height:100%;background-color:var(--theme-bg-sec, #1a1a1a);background-image:url(https://image.mux.com/UFhRUS0261RoziCyY9P8iGqY4MEW02MDtOut2VdQOczcA/thumbnail.jpg?time=0);background-size:cover;background-position:center"></div></div></figure>
<h3 id="coding-with-cursor-in-jetbrains-ides" class="anchor-heading group "><a href="#coding-with-cursor-in-jetbrains-ides" class="anchor-link" aria-label="Link to this section"><span class="anchor-icon" aria-hidden="true">#</span></a>Coding with Cursor in JetBrains IDEs</h3>
<p>Using Cursor ACP in JetBrains IDEs offers many of the benefits that make our agents effective across all surfaces.</p>
<p>Different models are better suited for different kinds of tasks. With Cursor ACP, developers can explore and choose <a href="https://cursor.com/docs/models-and-pricing" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">frontier models</a> from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Cursor. Our agent harness is also custom-built for every model to optimize output quality and performance.</p>
<p>Cursor also uses secure codebase indexing and semantic search to understand large enterprise codebases. ACP combines these capabilities with deep code intelligence and tooling in JetBrains IDEs.</p>
<div class="card mb-v2"><blockquote class="not-prose"><p class="type-base whitespace-pre-wrap">JetBrains has always seen its mission as bringing the best of the industry to our users. I&#x27;m very excited about Cursor becoming a special guest in the family of ACP-compliant agents in JetBrains IDEs. In this setup, developers stay in control of their environment, while Cursor brings the powerful AI assistance that has earned it such popularity. This collaboration looks like a win for Cursor, for JetBrains, and most importantly for developers.</p></blockquote><div class="mt-v1 flex items-center space-x-(--grid-gap)"><div><div class="type-sm">Aleksey Stukalov</div><div class="type-sm text-theme-text-sec">Head of IDEs Division<!-- -->, <!-- -->JetBrains</div></div></div></div>
<h3 id="getting-started" class="anchor-heading group "><a href="#getting-started" class="anchor-link" aria-label="Link to this section"><span class="anchor-icon" aria-hidden="true">#</span></a>Getting started</h3>
<p>Install the Cursor ACP directly in your JetBrains IDE from the ACP Registry, and authenticate with your existing Cursor account. The Cursor ACP is free for all users on paid plans. Learn more in the <a href="https://cursor.com/docs/cli/acp#ide-integrations" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">docs</a>.</p>
<h3 id="whats-next" class="anchor-heading group "><a href="#whats-next" class="anchor-link" aria-label="Link to this section"><span class="anchor-icon" aria-hidden="true">#</span></a>What&#x27;s next</h3>
<p>The Cursor ACP is a foundation for deeper integrations with JetBrains. We&#x27;re excited to bring agentic coding capabilities to more developers.</p></div><footer class="mt-v2"><p class="type-base"><span class="text-theme-text-sec">Filed under:<!-- --> </span><a class="text-theme-text hover:text-theme-text/75 active:text-theme-text capitalize" href="/blog/topic/product">product</a></p><p class="type-base text-theme-text-sec">Author<!-- -->:<!-- --> <!-- xl:hidden" href="/blog/topic/product">product</a></div><h1 class="type-lg text-balance">Cursor is now available in JetBrains IDEs</h1><div class="mt-v5/12 type-base text-theme-text-mid"><span class="text-theme-text-mid">2 min read</span></div></header></div></div><div class="col-span-full grid grid-cols-subgrid xl:col-start-7 xl:col-end-19"><div class="col-span-full mx-auto w-full max-w-[48rem]"><div class="min-w-0"><nav id="contents" class="card card--text mb-v2 type-sm"><button class="flex w-full items-center justify-between text-left" aria-expanded="true" aria-controls="toc-content"><h3 class="text-theme-text-sec">Table of Contents</h3><span class="text-theme-text-sec transition-transform duration-200"><span class="icon-glyph-11" aria-hidden="true">↑</span></span></button><div id="toc-content" class="mt-v1/12"><ul><li><a href="#coding-with-cursor-in-jetbrains-ides" class="py-v1/12 hover:text-theme-text-sec block ">Coding with Cursor in JetBrains IDEs</a></li><li><a href="#getting-started" class="py-v1/12 hover:text-theme-text-sec block ">Getting started</a></li><li><a href="#whats-next" class="py-v1/12 hover:text-theme-text-sec block ">What&#x27;s next</a></li></ul></div></nav><div class="prose prose--block prose--blog col-span-full!"><p>Cursor is now available in IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, and other JetBrains IDEs through the <a href="https://agentclientprotocol.com/" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">Agent Client Protocol</a> (ACP).</p>
<p>Developers who rely on IntelliJ IDEA and other <a href="https://www.jetbrains.com/ides/" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">JetBrains IDEs</a> for strong Java and multilanguage support can now use any frontier model with Cursor for agent-driven development.</p>
<figure class="!my-1"><div style="aspect-ratio:1684 / 1080;overflow:hidden"><div class="media-border-container media-controller w-full " style="width:100%;height:100%;background-color:var(--theme-bg-sec, #1a1a1a);background-image:url(https://image.mux.com/UFhRUS0261RoziCyY9P8iGqY4MEW02MDtOut2VdQOczcA/thumbnail.jpg?time=0);background-size:cover;background-position:center"></div></div></figure>
<h3 id="coding-with-cursor-in-jetbrains-ides" class="anchor-heading group "><a href="#coding-with-cursor-in-jetbrains-ides" class="anchor-link" aria-label="Link to this section"><span class="anchor-icon" aria-hidden="true">#</span></a>Coding with Cursor in JetBrains IDEs</h3>
<p>Using Cursor ACP in JetBrains IDEs offers many of the benefits that make our agents effective across all surfaces.</p>
<p>Different models are better suited for different kinds of tasks. With Cursor ACP, developers can explore and choose <a href="https://cursor.com/docs/models-and-pricing" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">frontier models</a> from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and Cursor. Our agent harness is also custom-built for every model to optimize output quality and performance.</p>
<p>Cursor also uses secure codebase indexing and semantic search to understand large enterprise codebases. ACP combines these capabilities with deep code intelligence and tooling in JetBrains IDEs.</p>
<div class="card mb-v2"><blockquote class="not-prose"><p class="type-base whitespace-pre-wrap">JetBrains has always seen its mission as bringing the best of the industry to our users. I&#x27;m very excited about Cursor becoming a special guest in the family of ACP-compliant agents in JetBrains IDEs. In this setup, developers stay in control of their environment, while Cursor brings the powerful AI assistance that has earned it such popularity. This collaboration looks like a win for Cursor, for JetBrains, and most importantly for developers.</p></blockquote><div class="mt-v1 flex items-center space-x-(--grid-gap)"><div><div class="type-sm">Aleksey Stukalov</div><div class="type-sm text-theme-text-sec">Head of IDEs Division<!-- -->, <!-- -->JetBrains</div></div></div></div>
<h3 id="getting-started" class="anchor-heading group "><a href="#getting-started" class="anchor-link" aria-label="Link to this section"><span class="anchor-icon" aria-hidden="true">#</span></a>Getting started</h3>
<p>Install the Cursor ACP directly in your JetBrains IDE from the ACP Registry, and authenticate with your existing Cursor account. The Cursor ACP is free for all users on paid plans. Learn more in the <a href="https://cursor.com/docs/cli/acp#ide-integrations" rel="noopener noreferrer" target="_blank">docs</a>.</p>
<h3 id="whats-next" class="anchor-heading group "><a href="#whats-next" class="anchor-link" aria-label="Link to this section"><span class="anchor-icon" aria-hidden="true">#</span></a>What&#x27;s next</h3>
<p>The Cursor ACP is a foundation for deeper integrations with JetBrains. We&#x27;re excited to bring agentic coding capabilities to more developers.</p></div><footer class="mt-v2"><p class="type-base"><span class="text-theme-text-sec">Filed under:<!-- --> </span><a
